conviction_note: abs_move 13% (median of six prior reactions is 14.4%, thin $130k/day tape, first call under a new CEO and a strategy pivot) times a 55% lean up: the reported quarter should clear a weakly sourced $7.2M bar on Q3's $8.0M run-rate and insiders bought $7.7M six weeks after the quarter closed, against the risk that the first Berger call frames FY27 as an investment year for DataSeeds with buybacks suspended, which is how the FQ4 FY25 'year of innovation' print fell 24%. The findings sum (+2.0) and the scaled number (+1.3) agree in sign; the gap is the guidance uncertainty, which p_up carries.

Company gives no guidance (Q3 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001667313/000121390026067834/ea029448101ex99-1.htm). A stale Seeking Alpha FY estimate of $29.77M (Mar 2026) would imply only ~$5.9M for Q4.

Options chain unusable (ATM spread 133% of mid, OI 170, put/call OI 2.21), no skew available. The June print's +25.7% one-day pop (3.31 -> 4.16) fully reversed to 3.01 within three sessions (Yahoo daily bars).

findings.finding: FQ4 (May-Jul 2026) revenue should land around $7.7-8.0M against a $7.2M single-source consensus: Q1-Q3 FY26 ran $7.6M/$8.3M/$8.0M, subscription revenue grew 31.9% to $1.7M in Q3 with active subscriptions +41% and deferred revenue +26%, while the only drag named, Emojipedia advertising after Google's Sept 2025 SERP change, still faces a pre-change comp in Q4 (Q4 FY25 was $7.5M, ad $5.2M). Net estimate ~+8% vs bar, ~+4% YoY.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beat 4 straight quarters per Benzinga; reactions: Q3 FY26 (Jun 11, $8.0M vs $7.0M) +25.7% then fully reversed in 3 sessions; Q1 FY26 (Dec 12) +14.4%; Q2 FY26 (Mar 12, +18% revenue but $3.6M Emojipedia impairment) -14.5%; FQ4 FY25 (Oct 28 2025, flat revenue, adj EBITDA -60%) -24.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The only visible consensus ($7.2M, ~$0.04) sits below every FY26 quarter so far; if the market priced an ~$8M quarter the stock would not be trading 7.5% under the price insiders paid in September and down 12% in 20 days. One or two estimates, no previews found.
findings.independence: Same company data as the Q3 8-K exhibit (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001667313/000121390026067834/ea029448101ex99-1.htm) — one document family, counted once. Emojipedia drag from the Q3 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1667313/000121390026068278/ea0293880-10q_zedge.htm) is netted into this estimate, not filed separately.

findings.finding: Alphabet's Q2 2026 10-Q (Apr-Jun, two-thirds of Zedge's FQ4) reports AdMob revenue increased while Network impressions fell 12% and cost-per-impression rose 13% — in-app ad pricing firm during the quarter, consistent with Zedge's ARPMAU (+21% in Q3) continuing to offset MAU decline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Advertising is ~67% of revenue; Q3 ad -4% YoY (all Emojipedia) did not stop a +25.7% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro proxy nobody maps to a $43M microcap; small because it is transmission the company has not confirmed.
findings.independence: proxy only; company-level corroboration is Zedge's own Q3 ARPMAU +21.2% (Q3 8-K exhibit).

findings.finding: This is the first print and call under new CEO Morris Berger (from Oct 1) after the company declared DataSeeds 'now our primary growth initiative', raised $7.7M from insiders to hire sales/engineering/production talent, buy datasets and pursue acqui-hires, and warned 'DataSeeds revenue lumpy over upcoming quarters' — the call is likely to frame FY27 as an investment year with higher opex and lower adjusted EBITDA (FY26 YTD adj EBITDA $3.6M, 15% margin).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FQ4 FY25 release framed FY26 as 'a year of innovation' with no numeric guide and adj EBITDA down 60%: stock -24.3%. The Aug 31 2026 pivot announcement itself traded +5.9% (2.87 -> 3.04 on 949K shares) and then bled to 2.71.
findings.why_not_priced: No spend number has been given; the market knows the strategy but not the opex bill. Financing question answered: the money buys a DataSeeds ramp corroborated by repeat/larger follow-on orders, a first model-evaluation engagement (Bria, Oct 19) and open hiring, so the raise itself is not distress — the risk is the margin path, and the size of a DataSeeds pipeline disclosure could cut either way.
findings.independence: Oct 2026 investor deck (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1667313/000121390026111195/ea030927101ex99-1.htm) repeats the use of proceeds and 'lumpy' warning — same company narrative, counted once.

findings.finding: Vice Chairman Howard Jonas (via Chartwell, $6.5M), director Elliot Gibber ($0.65M) and another holder bought 2.62M new Class B shares at $2.93-$2.98 with 90% warrant coverage on Sept 8-11, six weeks after the FQ4 books closed (Jul 31), and Jonas's 13D says he will 'work closely with management' on DataSeeds; the stock now trades at $2.71, below their price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior insider placement in the baseline window; the announcement day traded +5.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Board insiders committing $7.15M at market with the quarter's results largely known is evidence the quarter is not a disaster; the market has instead drifted 7.5% below their price, which would not have happened if the signal were weighted.

findings.finding: Share repurchases were suspended on Aug 31 (buyback had bought 0.33M shares in FY26 YTD and had $2.2M fresh capacity from June), removing a regular bid from a stock that trades ~49K shares a day; the dividend continues.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock has drifted from ~$3.05 to $2.71 since; the print may confirm no resumption.

findings.finding: Fiscal year-end impairment risk: $2.1M goodwill (accumulated $8.7M already impaired) and $1.1M remaining Emojipedia asset after the Q2 $3.6M write-down, with GuruShots still losing $0.7M a quarter; a year-end test could put another GAAP charge into FQ4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 FY26 print carrying the $3.6M Emojipedia impairment and a GAAP loss fell -14.5% despite +18% revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: Not quantified anywhere and not in the consensus; small because the remaining balances are small ($3.2M max) and non-cash.

findings.finding: MAU keeps shrinking (19.6M in Q3, -11.3% YoY; 20.4M in Q2; 23.2M in Q4 FY25), so FQ4 MAU is likely ~19M, down ~17% vs Q4 FY25's 23.2M on the reported figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: MAU fell ~11% YoY in every recent quarter including those that rose 14-26%; the line has not driven the reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced; a known trend, filed small.
findings.independence: same deck as finding 1 (operating metrics page), separate line.

findings.finding: Pro-forma cash $27.4M and no debt against a ~$43M market cap (pro-forma EV $15.7M, TTM FCF $3.1M, ~20% FCF yield per the company's Oct deck) — roughly $1.75 of cash per share under a $2.71 stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none; valuation has not prevented -14% and -24% reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced (it is the company's own slide); cushions downside on a miss rather than driving the move.
findings.independence: shares the deck with findings 1 and 7.

outside_window.finding: Warrants on 2.35M Class B shares at $3.22-$3.28 become exercisable only after stockholder approval and six months post-closing (~March 2027); potential further dilution/insider funding.

baseline_tension: No skew to agree or disagree with; the mild long lean cuts against a -12% 20-day drift and a history in which the fiscal Q4 print (Oct 2025) fell 24%, so p_up stays only 5 points above 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar single-sourced, Benzinga snippet only, sources disagreed on Q3): revenue finding capped from +2.5 to +2.0.
Rule 5 (macro proxy vs company-level number): Alphabet AdMob proxy cut from +0.5 to +0.3.
Rule 2 (unquantified reported-quarter impairment has paid; this name fell 14.5% on its last impairment print): impairment finding enlarged from -0.3 to -0.5.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): kept the insider raise as non-negative and the guidance finding framed on the margin path, not distress; no size change.
Rule 7: short interest checked (~1 day to cover, not crowded) before the negatives; no change. abs_move_pct and p_up unchanged.
